screens.title: George Agapov — Technical architect and engineering leader
screens.description: George Agapov is a technical architect and engineering leader based in Andorra, working on distributed systems, high-assurance software, AI-assisted engineering and independent products and research through Yak Software.

screens.title: Work — George Agapov
screens.description: Selected work, most recent first: technical architecture at o1Labs and five years on the Mina protocol, the Molt Petit consensus protocol, Yak Software, StakerBridge, Tezos tooling, Cardano SL and teaching — the longer arc behind georgeee.com.

screens.title: About — George Agapov
screens.description: About George Agapov: life in Andorra, in the Pyrenees — trails, classical music, Proust and Catalan — with direct contacts on email, GitHub, LinkedIn, X and Telegram.
